title: Have You Been Convinced? A Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning Approach to Detecting Persuasiveness in ChangeMyView Discussions
abstract: arXiv:2610.15091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Argument structures represent how individual arguments interact within a discourse. However, leveraging these structures to infer meaningful knowledge remains challenging, as it requires a formal representation of how argumentative influence propagates across the structure. We propose Neuro-symbolic Argumentation Reasoning System (NARS) for performing persuasiveness detection directly from online discussions. The neural component employs retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning to extract bipolar argument structures, while the symbolic component applies gradual argumentation semantics to propagate argumentative influence over the structure. translated_title: 你被说服了吗？一种用于检测ChangeMyView讨论中说服力的神经符号论证推理方法
translated_abstract: 论证结构表示话语中各个论证之间如何相互作用。然而，利用这些结构来推断有意义的知识仍然具有挑战性，因为这需要对论证影响如何在结构中传播进行形式化表示。我们提出了神经符号论证推理系统（NARS），用于直接从在线讨论中进行说服力检测。神经组件采用检索增强的迭代大语言模型推理来提取双极论证结构，而符号组件则应用渐进论证语义在结构上传播论证影响。基于Webis-CMV-20语料库，我们构建了CMV2BAS——一个由长篇、多线程ChangeMyView讨论组成的数据集，其中标注了由大语言模型生成的双极论证结构，并用delta事件（观点改变 vs. 无改变）进行标记。我们研究了渐进论证语义能否有效……
tldr: 提出了神经符号论证推理系统NARS，将大语言模型驱动的双极论证结构提取与渐进论证语义的论证影响传播相结合，并构建了带有说服力标注的CMV2BAS数据集，用于检测ChangeMyView在线讨论中的说服力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NARS, a neuro-symbolic argumentation reasoning system that combines retrieval-augmented iterative LLM reasoning for extracting bipolar argument structures with gradual argumentation semantics for propagating argumentative influence, and introduces the CMV2BAS dataset to detect persuasiveness in ChangeMyView discussions.
